# 4. Embossing (use case 9-10)


- How to detect where to make the changes
- How to make the changes
- How to Run Batch Card Embossing
- Screenshots
- Links



## Introduction

In this document we will cover all the development steps were made in order to execute embossing procedure to export XML file.


## How to detect where to make the changes

PowerCard UI  Configure screen PAN Carrier - MAIL DELIVERY INFO (TAB)    Fill Delivery Supplier Code.

Using "Inspect" (Google Chrome-right click)   Sources  cardCarrier.module.chunk.js

Found details for pwc-server (D:\Git_Repo\PowerCardSIA\cosmote_packaging\pwc-server\paramsCardholder\src\main\resources\paramsCardholder. btdesign) :

MODULE = 'paramsCardholder';

SERVICE = 'Emb_card_carrier';

On LINUX SERVER in pwc-unix folder search in  shl folder for  script   called "card_embossing.sh"

View card_embossing.sh  card_embossing.pc (../pwc-unix/Source/src/backoff/interfaces)

Find PL/SQL

View card_embossing.sh  card_embossing.pc (../pwc-unix/Source/src/backoff/interfaces)

Find PL/SQL

PCRD_CARD_EMBOSSING_PROCESSING.GENERATE_EMBOSSING_FILE_MAIN  PCRD_EMB_GEN_CARDCARRIER. GENERATE_XML_BLOCK_CARDCARRIER  MAIL_DELIVERY_INFO_XML_BLOCK


## How to make the changes

Features Group 3: Assign Courier range numbers to cards Technical Specification Document  (DTS)

DB Changes:

Add PL/SQL code in  PCRD_EMB_GEN_CARDCARRIER.MAIL_DELIVERY_INFO_XML_BLOCK

U.I and SERVER Changes:

The task involved in adding two info fields on payment instrument screeen


- 1.  Delivery supplier code: It refer the Courrier name and code
- 2.  Range number:  It refer the Courrier number which take the card.


The first task was first to identify whether his kind of functionality is offered from PowerCard or identify where we could intervene as to provide this functionality.

The screen of in Issuing / Operations/ Payment instrument seemed to fit the requirements. "Payment instrument"

How to locate the component that need to change in U.I. and Server.

One of the crucial matters is how to locate the screen, in terms of the U.I. and the Server, where the additional code must be inserted.

How to locate the component that need to change in U.I. and Server.

One of the crucial matters is how to locate the screen, in terms of the U.I. and the Server, where the additional code must be inserted.

The Browser assist us in locating the code. In case of Chrome we use More Tools  Developer Tools.

The open a debug window showing the posting of the page.

For the  U.I. we look under the submenu of the Sources Developer Tools:

In order to locate the element on the U.I., simply select and element (=input box), right click on the element and from the pop up menu select " " Inspect

For the Server we look under the submenu of the Network Developer Tools:

In order to get a request from the server pressing a button e.g. "Search" button will do the job in reveling the server side component.

Building the additional two fields (= delivery_supplier_code - delivery_supplier_number )


## 1. pwc-db (Oracle Server)

Folder 002_Tables

CARD.sql

CARD_DF.sql

CARD_VAL.sql

CARD_VAL_SAVE.sql

PKG_CARD_DELIV_SUPPL_DTL.sql

PKG_DELIVERY_SUPPLIER_RANGES_DF.sql

Folder 004_Constraints_NonFK

pk_pkg_card_deliv_suppl_dtl.sql unq_pkg_card_deliv_suppl_dtl.sql

Folder 005_Triggers

TGR_AD_CARD.sql

TGR_BI_CARD.sql TGR_BU_CARD.sql tgr_ad_pkg_card_deliv_suppl_dtl.sql tgr_bu_pkg_card_deliv_suppl_dtl.sql


# Folder 007_Constraints_FK

FK_CARD_DELIVERY_SUPPLIER.sql fk_pkg_card_deliv_suppl_dtl.sql


## Folder 013_Packages

PCRD_EMB_GEN_CARDCARRIER.PBK PCRD_CARD_EMBOSSING_PROCESSING.PBK


## Folder 016_Ressource_Bundle

20210222_PKG_DELIVERY_SUPPLIER_INFO.sql


## 2. pwc-server (application server)

Again we clone the branch. Checkout or build are own feature branch and add our changes.

On the server-side after locating the path next we go ..\pwc-server\cardholder\src\main\resources\cardholder.btdesign Cardholder, (IntelliJIDEA is used to open the tree structure of the server code)

The full path is therefore and the file is : cardholder/src/main/resources/ cardholder.btdesign

The full path is therefore and the file is : cardholder/src/main/resources/ cardholder.btdesign


In the file we search for which is the name of the Entity that we will implement our changes. cardholder.btdesign Card , The sections that need to be altered are:
- a. Card Entity
- b. CardVO
- c. Compilation
- i.  After the changes save on the btddesign file, right click on the directory that contains our file changes do TortoiseGit  Clean Up
- ii.  Next we go to the directory pwc-server\cardholder,  do a cmd on the directory, and at command prompt, we invoke maven complication


mvn clean install -Dmaven.test.skip=true

Then we replace the *.jar produce we replace into the v3_31-web.war. Redeploy into jboss.

Or by directing to the v3_31-parent directory and we execute


## mvn install

This will produce the v3_31-web.war in the target subdirectory i.e. pwc-server\v3-31-web\target and we deploy the war to jboss


- (v3-31-parent\pom.xml ?)
- d.  Final step is to upload our code to bitbucket.


Since we know the file and the path of the file we add git add cardholder/src/main/resources/cardholder.btdesigngit push

Since we know the file and the path of the file we add git add cardholder/src/main/resources/cardholder.btdesigngit push

git commit -m "pkg-10: delivery supplier code and number on payment instrument screen"


## 3. pwc-ui (u.i.)

The pwc-ui is cloned, we make or checkout our feature branch.

We open the source code using Visual Studio (V.S.)

We comment the file mention in 0. Introduction, in order to speed up UI complilation

Next we go the branch that we detected, in the U.I. in V.S. \src\app\operation\issuing\product\payment-instruments


The files that we change are located in the subdirectories:
- ../src/app/operation/issuing/product/payment-instruments/payment-instruments.config.ts
- ../src/app/operation/issuing/product/payment-instruments/view/steps/identification/identification-step.component.html
- ../src/app/operation/issuing/product/payment-instruments/vo/payment-instruments.entity.ts
- ../src/assets-test/operation/issuing/paymentInstruments.mock.json


Uploaded code (pwc-ui) in Bitbucket :  s://toolbox.sia.eu/bitbucket/projects/SIAHPS/repos/pwc-ui/compare/diff? http targetBranch=1e39752aa50cbc0838824c8577ebe3aeeb41c7b3&sourceBranch=535536742f1ad0dcac6548430aa87f72de652333&targetRepoId=5112


## Compilation

The compilation command in given from the Terminal window in V.S. :

node --max_old_space_size=4096 ./node_modules/@angular/cli/bin/ng serve

(We have already run at command in the directory and correctly configured file in the User profile directory) npm install pwc-ui .npmrc

node --max_old_space_size=4096 ./node_modules/@angular/cli/bin/ng serve

(We have already run at command in the directory and correctly configured file in the User profile directory) npm install pwc-ui .npmrc

Once the code has been compiled "successfully" (Compiled with warning), we can view our code on Powercard UI. at the URL:

http://localhost:4200/#/login


## How to Run Batch Card Embossing


- Open your Docker container
- docker exec -it yourContainerId bash
- Go to Root folder:
- cd root
- And run the file: ".profile"
- . .profile
- Necessary Resource Binaries
- HSM
- CMD_SERVER
- Go to:
- cd /root/pwc-unix/Source/usr/shl
- Start the " " resource binary: CMD_SERVER
- sh start_cmd_srv_01
- Go to the in VDI and open it (by clicking the red button) HSM Simulator


(!! If HSM Simulator is not opened, HSM Resource Binary cannot start !!)

(!! If HSM Simulator is not opened, HSM Resource Binary cannot start !!)


- Start the " " resource binary: HSM
- sh start_hsm_prod_01
- To make sure that the binaries have been properly started type:
- ps
- You should see and resource binaries appear in the list of running processes CMD_SERVER HSM
- If not, you need to go to " " folder to find out what happened to each binary trace
- cd  /root/pwc-unix/Source/usr/trace
- Then execute the following:
- cd  /root/pwc-unix/Source/usr/shl
- sh card_embossing.sh trc-000


(For more details refer to section Links about  pwc-unix on docker)
